title: NiLeSMP
description: NiLeSMP is a small Minecraft survival economy server that is still in its first season. It focuses on player-driven trading, building, and community progression.
body:
NiLeSMP is a Minecraft survival economy server where players can trade, build farms, form teams, and compete to become the richest player. It supports crossplay between Java and Bedrock editions, and works on versions 1.13 and up, though playing on 1.19 or newer is recommended. Players can explore, cooperate, and strategize in a growing community-driven world, making every season a new adventure. The server IP is: _**nilesmp.g-portal.game**_
